events.event: BPS reported Indonesia's Q3 2026 GDP grew 5.47% year on year, well above the roughly 5.2% consensus.
events.key_numbers: GDP +5.47% yoy (Q3 2026) · consensus 5.20% (CNBC poll of 15 institutions); Permata 5.23%, Danamon ~5%, LPEM UI 5.28% · Q2 2026 5.29%, Q1 2026 5.61% · household consumption +5.04% (2.62 pp contribution) · investment (PMTB) +6.06% · government consumption +8.95% (MBG, civil-servant pay) · manufacturing 1.20 pp, trade 0.94 pp, construction 0.62 pp, ICT 0.49 pp · nominal GDP Rp6,741.0 T · unemployed 7.38 million in Aug 2026 (-77,000 yoy)
events.why_it_matters: Ekonomi tumbuh lebih cepat dari perkiraan di tengah pasar saham yang jatuh, tapi sebagian dorongan datang dari belanja pemerintah (MBG, gaji ASN).
events.spreading_evidence: detikFinance, CNBC Indonesia and Antara all headline it; detik terpopuler has BPS explainer story

events.event: The IHSG rebounded 2.25% to close at 5,030.26 on 5 November, back above 5,000 after the 3 November crash.
events.key_numbers: IHSG 5,030.26 (+110.49 pts, +2.25%) · open 4,998.34, low 4,995.46, high 5,072.05 · turnover about Rp9.06 T, 212.92 million lots · sectors: technology +4.60%, basic materials +3.48% · gainers BBCA, AMMN, TLKM, MDKA, BBNI · draggers BRPT, AADI, TPIA, EXCL, PANI · previous close 4,919.77 (4 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: IHSG kembali di atas 5.000 setelah anjlok, dipicu kabar PDB; investor ritel lihat apakah pemulihan ini bertahan.

events.event: The rupiah strengthened 0.44% to Rp18,075 per US dollar on 5 November on the GDP beat and a softer dollar.
events.key_numbers: Rp18,075/US$ (Refinitiv) vs Rp18,155 on 4 Nov (+0.44%) · intraday Rp18,055-18,170 · DXY -0.16% to 101.405
events.why_it_matters: Rupiah masih di atas Rp18.000, jadi harga barang impor dan cicilan berdolar tetap tertekan.

events.event: OJK said foreign investors net sold Rp16.88 trillion of Indonesian stocks in October 2026 while the IHSG fell 16.7%, blaming the MSCI reclassification announcement.
events.key_numbers: foreign net sell Rp16.88 T (Oct 2026) · IHSG 5,057 at end-Oct, -16.7% mom · foreign net buy of SBN Rp9.55 T · average daily value Rp16.31 T (Sep Rp14.94 T; YTD Rp20.34 T) · investors +1.38 million in a month to 33.55 million (+64.75% YTD) · 26 offerings worth Rp24.46 T in pipeline · mutual fund NAV Rp620.14 T (-2.66% mom)
events.why_it_matters: Asing keluar dari saham tapi masuk ke obligasi, sementara jumlah investor ritel domestik terus naik.

events.event: OJK said it imposed Rp2.23 trillion in administrative fines on 169 capital-market violators in January-October 2026, plus licence revocations and suspensions.
events.key_numbers: fines Rp2.23 T on 169 parties (Jan-Oct 2026) · 6 licence revocations · 8 licence suspensions · 1 registration certificate cancelled · 27 written warnings · 5 written orders
events.why_it_matters: OJK menunjukkan penegakan aturan pasar modal, hal yang disorot MSCI dan investor asing.

events.event: The Finance Ministry's debt office reported government debt of Rp10,326.93 trillion at end-September 2026, 40.30% of GDP.
events.why_it_matters: Utang Rp10.000 triliun lebih terdengar menakutkan, tapi rasio terhadap PDB justru turun karena ekonomi tumbuh cepat.

events.event: OJK told Bank MNC Internasional (BABP) to resolve customers' withdrawal problems, saying the bank still meets minimum capital and urging customers not to panic.
events.key_numbers: BABP shares -65% in 10 months · deposits down about Rp2.7 T in a year · Q3 2026 profit -22%, deposits -17% · one customer cited a Rp500,000 withdrawal cap at a branch on 2 Nov · BABP still meets capital requirement
events.why_it_matters: Nasabah bank yang kesulitan menarik uang bikin orang cemas soal keamanan tabungan, padahal simpanan dijamin LPS sampai batas tertentu.

events.event: OJK reported outstanding online lending (pinjol) debt reached Rp106.48 trillion in September 2026, with non-performing loans above 5%.
events.key_numbers: outstanding Rp106.48 T (Sep 2026), +17.02% yoy · TWP90 5.36% · MSME financing +12.49% yoy · bank credit growth 13% (CNBC headline) · OJK asked banks to block 39,923 accounts linked to online gambling
events.why_it_matters: Utang pinjol naik cepat dan kredit macetnya di atas 5%, tanda tekanan di kantong banyak orang.

events.event: KSPI and Partai Buruh president Said Iqbal estimated layoffs could exceed 90,000 workers by end-2026, citing about 83,000 so far in Ministry of Manpower data.
events.key_numbers: KSPI estimate above 90,000 by end-2026 · about 83,000 per Kemnaker (as cited by Said) · KSPI count ~70,000 as of June · PT Ghim Li Indonesia (Batam) about 1,170 workers · PT Parkland World Indonesia 6 (Lebak) closed; Jepara plant still about 8,000 workers · detik: seamless pipe imports threaten layoffs
events.why_it_matters: PHK terus terjadi di tekstil dan alas kaki meski PDB tumbuh 5,47%, jadi angka pertumbuhan belum tentu terasa di pekerja pabrik.
events.spreading_evidence: detikFinance terpopuler #4 covers PHK risk from pipe imports

events.event: Ultrajaya (ULTJ) holds an EGM on 6 November to approve acquiring 100% of PT Frisian Flag Indonesia for Rp14.57 trillion via a rights issue, making FrieslandCampina its controlling shareholder.
events.key_numbers: deal Rp14.57 T, non-cash (inbreng) · up to 7.88 billion new shares at Rp2,150 exercise price, ~6.78 billion to FFI sellers · sellers: FrieslandCampina 78.09%, Blue Waves 16.91%, Bahtera Wiraniaga 5% · Sabana Prawirawidjaja stake 53.17% -> 32.19% · max dilution 43.11% · EGM postponed from 27 Oct after OJK asked for clarification · mandatory tender offer follows
events.why_it_matters: Susu Ultra Milk dan Frisian Flag, dua merek yang ada di rumah banyak orang, akan digabung dalam satu perusahaan.

events.event: US jobs data is due on 6 November, with markets pricing a Fed rate hike in December as likely, which matters for the rupiah.
events.key_numbers: Fed hike odds for December 80.7% (Reuters/CME FedWatch via CNBC Indonesia; other outlets cite different figures) · US payrolls due Fri 6 Nov · DXY 101.405 · rupiah Rp18,075
events.why_it_matters: Kenaikan bunga The Fed bisa menekan rupiah lagi dan membuat BI sulit menurunkan bunga.

events.event: GoTo said shareholders approved on 14 October cancelling its treasury shares and ending its buyback, with analysts saying it trades at a deep discount to peers.
events.key_numbers: RUPSLB approval 14 Oct 2026 · GoTo Q3 2026 net profit Rp441 billion (third profitable quarter) · EV/EBITDA 3.3x vs 13-14x peers (Kiwoom Sekuritas)
events.why_it_matters: Pemegang saham GOTO punya persentase kepemilikan lebih besar tanpa menambah saham.
